title: Add dedupe and leakage assertions for bios dev-100, FINAL and pool
description:
## Purpose

Assert that bios dev, final and labeled pools cannot leak into each other.

## Scope

dev-100 and FINAL (fixed-seed 1,000, `--final-size`) disjoint and drawn from test; twins follow their originals; pool vs test check by normalized hash and 100-char prefix (known: 19 prefix matches, 2 exact duplicates) with matches excluded or reported; record that test items were scored in earlier studies (not pristine).

## Definition of done

Assertions fail loudly in specs on a planted duplicate; split manifest (ids and hashes only) written. Cost: $0.
